protocol.hypothesis: A time-varying blend under one fixed HT command can restore robust feasibility or reduce conservative cost at least1% versus the best constant blend under identical temporal and stock constraints. Full and conditional delay<=1h results are distinct.
protocol.ht: One command at t=0, held through the window; no adaptive knowledge of the uncertainty world or future measurements.
protocol.time: Equal periods from0 to input horizon<=3h; step15/30/60min must divide horizon. Each period is delivered at a constant mixture and flow throughout its interval. Check both endpoints, including t=0, not only the final horizon.
protocol.inventory: clean/heavy stocks in tonnes, no replenishment; fixed properties. Consumption=flow*fraction*duration. Additive supply unbounded within3% dose; unused HT output goes to unmodeled storage, as before.
protocol.grid: 45 HT commands x77 blends, duplicate current point removed; clean/heavy shares0.1 and additive0.005 steps unchanged. DP states are exact cumulative clean/heavy consumption units of demand*period_hours*0.1, stocks rounded down to reachable grid states only.
protocol.robustness: Same972 fixed worlds, conditional486 separately. Quality/capacity at both interval endpoints. Monotone sulfur removal ratio and linear quality/effective flow imply endpoint extrema; cost convex in response fraction implies endpoint maximum.
protocol.corner_reduction: Worst sulfur k=0.9, worst T95 bias=+5, worst CN gain=0.75; enumerate all delays and endpoints. Cost maxima over energy0.75/1.25 and clean price1.2. Validate against all972 worlds independently.
protocol.objective: Minimize sum over periods of period_mass*maximum_endpoint_world_unit_cost. Conservative upper bound, not actual integrated cost nor global-world minimax/regret. Same objective for stationary and dynamic. Earlier5% regret gate remains unchanged in v2 and is not transferred to this different objective.
protocol.tie_break: Ascending HT-grid order, then ascending accumulated stock units; DP keeps first equal-cost transition within1e-10.
protocol.frontier: At each possible start period, solve delivery of all remaining periods through the same end time. Deferred early volume is explicitly unmet, never a successful original order. No automatic quality/volume relaxation.
protocol.acceptance: Every delivered period passes all world constraints, inventory never negative, totals reconcile, dynamic cost<=feasible best stationary cost within tolerance; scientific gain requires >=1% cost reduction or dynamic-only feasibility on at least one preregistered scenario, reported separately by uncertainty scope.
protocol.limits: Model demonstration, not causal validation. No AVT control optimization, real inventories, replenishment, repeated HT commands or online replanning. No training/production data reads. Full-world feasibility at nodes only.
